description: Gold verdicts for benchmark_manuscript.md. Used to regression-test the auditor. 'metadata_expected' is what retrieve_evidence.py should report deterministically; 'verdict_expected' is the support judgement the assistant should reach per references/evidence_rubric.md.

items.claim: Nucleoside-modified mRNA suppresses innate immune activation and increases translation.
items.note: Karikó 2005 is the canonical result; should validate and support.

items.claim: CAI is a strong, general predictor of protein expression across systems.
items.note: Kudla 2009 explicitly found codon bias did NOT correlate with expression.

items.claim: mRNA secondary structure has essentially no effect on protein output.
items.note: Mauger 2019 shows structure REGULATES expression via functional half-life.

items.claim: LinearDesign improved mRNA stability and immunogenicity, including in animal models.
items.note: Zhang 2023 Nature = LinearDesign, with in vivo data.

items.claim: Deep learning has solved RNA 3D structure prediction to protein-level quality.
items.note: Schneider 2023 argues RNA has NOT had its AlphaFold moment; claim overstates/contradicts.

items.claim: Global agencies issued a single unified binding law for AI in drug manufacturing.
items.note: Fabricated: no DOI, garbled agency authors, title matches no real record.

items.claim: Synonymous codon substitutions perturb co-translational folding in vivo (dated 2018).
items.note: Claim content matches Walsh, but the cited year 2018 is wrong (actual 2020) -> metadata mismatch should be flagged.
